faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DPAR Manipur State Chief Information Commissioner post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the State Chief Information Commissioner post is 15-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the State Chief Information Commissioner position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the State Chief Information Commissioner post is 65 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What are the eligibility criteria for the State Chief Information Commissioner role?
faq.answer: Candidates must be persons of eminence in public life with wide knowledge and experience in law, science and technology, social service, management, journalism, mass media or administration and governance. They must be a citizen of India and not of unsound mind, insolvent or convicted for any crime.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the State Chief Information Commissioner post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the post of State Chief Information Commissioner in the Department of Personnel & Administrative Reforms Manipur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the DPAR Manipur State Chief Information Commissioner recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the State Chief Information Commissioner post?
faq.answer: The salary details for the State Chief Information Commissioner post are not mentioned in the provided data. Please refer to the official notification for salary information.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the State Chief Information Commissioner position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the verification of testimonials, antecedents, and past service of the applicants.

faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Department of Personnel & Administrative Reforms Manipur, which is www.manipur.gov.in.
